title: Nourishing Jamaican Spice German Lamb Tagine
description: A tangy and crunchy German-inspired dish, featuring Jamaican curry powder, pickles, and a variety of herbs, perfectly suited for a cataplana vessel. This recipe is ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly and perfect for a meal any time of the day.
instructions: Heat oil in the cataplana over medium heat.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the Jamaican curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pickling spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lemons and cook until the liquid has evaporated, about 2 minutes.
Add enough water to cover the lamb and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 hour.
Skim off any excess fat and serve hot.
